usedFor: ActivityInfo collects forms and records for programs; Google Drive stores the documents around them. A “New Record” in ActivityInfo can run “Copy a File” in Drive, so each record gets its own copy of a report template.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in ActivityInfo, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new record gets a fresh copy in the folder you pick, optionally renamed, so a template turns into a working file per submission.

watchOut: “Updated Record” fires on every change, so “Copy a File” could make several copies for one record. Both ActivityInfo triggers are polling, so the copy follows the next check.
